content.text: The current ledger already claims ENP-FND-011 through ENP-FND-021 are corrected, so I’m testing those claims as recurrence oracles rather than accepting the task status. The first fresh review has identified several false greens; I’m now checking exact ownership and line references against the working tree.

The corrected fixtures are green: Codex 136 tests, Photon 44 tests, and both typechecks pass. Those checks still miss at least three concrete boundary failures: malformed redacted header values defect and expose the secret in the cause, deeply nested SSE JSON defects instead of entering the typed error channel, and duplicate sequence numbers produce duplicate user-visible deltas followed by a clean `[DONE]`.
Please conclude the bounded pass-one report now with the highest-confidence findings already established; do not broaden scope or edit files.

**Pass-One Findings**
1. **[P1] Config can route bearer credentials to an arbitrary endpoint.**  
   [contracts.ts:18](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:18), [config.ts:39](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/config.ts:39), [http-client.ts:71](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:71)  
   `CodexResponsesEndpoint` accepts any non-empty string, including `http://127.0.0.1/...` and attacker-controlled HTTPS URLs, before attaching the Codex bearer token.  
   **Earliest owner:** restrict the endpoint Schema to the approved HTTPS origin/path or an explicit allowlist.  
   **Oracle:** reject malformed, HTTP, loopback and foreign-host endpoint configuration before constructing an HTTP request.

2. **[P1] Malformed redacted credentials defect and expose the secret in the Cause.**  
   [credentials.ts:85](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/auth/credentials.ts:85), [credentials.ts:121](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/auth/credentials.ts:121), [http-client.ts:71](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:71)  
   A decoded access token containing a newline caused `Headers` to throw. The resulting defect included the complete token in its message. Account ID has the same weakness.  
   **Earliest owner:** constrain both credential Schemas to valid header values and translate defensive header-construction failures to a fixed tagged error.  
   **Oracle:** control-character sentinels must produce typed, secret-negative failures with no defect.

3. **[P1] Recursive JSON boundaries can overflow the stack outside the typed error channel.**  
   [contracts.ts:161](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:161), [server.ts:124](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/apps/codex-proxy/src/server.ts:124), [stream-events.ts:69](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-events.ts:69)  
   Deeply nested but sub-limit tool parameters and SSE JSON both reproduced `Die(RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded.)`.  
   **Earliest owner:** define bounded recursive JSON ownership for tool parameters and avoid decoding an entire SSE event through generic `Schema.Json` before selecting its concrete event Schema.  
   **Oracle:** deterministic depth-limit and limit-plus-one fixtures must return closed tagged failures, never defects.

4. **[P1] The proof can pass payloads that the live stream rejects.**  
   [http-client.ts:152](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:152), [stream-events.ts:69](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-events.ts:69), [stream-mapper.ts:109](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-mapper.ts:109)  
   A malformed `response.output_text.delta` missing `delta`, followed by a valid completion, returned proof success. The live mapper rejected the same stream.  
   **Earliest owner:** decode recognized events into one shared closed union before proof or live consumers diverge.  
   **Oracle:** every malformed recognized event fixture must fail identically in proof and live paths.

5. **[P1] Duplicate/out-of-order sequence numbers produce a clean duplicated response.**  
   [stream-events.ts:29](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-events.ts:29), [stream-events.ts:130](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-events.ts:130), [stream-mapper.ts:245](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-mapper.ts:245)  
   Two text deltas with sequence number `0`, followed by completion sequence `0`, emitted the text twice and then emitted `[DONE]`.  
   **Earliest owner:** the shared stream state machine must own expected sequence progression.  
   **Oracle:** duplicate, regressing and skipped sequence fixtures must fail proof and live streams without clean completion.

Repository checks remain green despite these failures: Codex `136/136`, Photon `44/44`, both package typechecks, `check:boundaries`, and `git diff --check`. The audit used installed `effect@4.0.0-beta.101` and local Effect revision `1caab3cc30f626efbf15e59d74f539a487e5c85c`.

No files, providers, credentials, deployments, commits, or documentation were changed. No live Codex, Photon, Preview or Production behaviour was tested.
